title: Factor IC Analysis (Rolling RankIC/ICIR)
description: Implement ICAnalyzer for cross-sectional IC computation, rolling RankIC with configurable window, ICIR, and IC positive ratio. Integrate with P6 FactorEngine's existing IC infrastructure.

criteria: ICAnalyzer computes cross-sectional RankIC: verify by py -m pytest tests/unit/test_ic_analyzer.py -p no:asyncio (exit code 0)
ICIR computed as mean/std: verify by assertion in tests
Rolling IC with configurable window: verify by window parameter test
IC positive ratio computed: verify by assertion in tests
convergence.definition_of_done: ICAnalyzer correctly computes RankIC, ICIR, rolling IC, and IC positive ratio from factor values and forward returns

files.change: ICAnalyzer class with compute_ic() and compute_ic_by_quintile() methods
Unit tests for ICAnalyzer: RankIC correctness, ICIR, rolling window, edge cases

implementation.title: Implement ICAnalyzer class
implementation.description: Create synapse/backtest/ic_analyzer.py with ICAnalyzer class. Constructor accepts window (default 20) and min_periods (default 10). compute_ic() takes factor_values DataFrame (MultiIndex date, ticker) and forward_returns Series (MultiIndex date, ticker), returns frozen ICAnalysisResult. For each date, compute cross-sectional RankIC using scipy.stats.spearmanr. Compute rolling IC with configurable window. Compute ICIR as mean(IC)/std(IC).
modification_points: Implement compute_ic() method: iterate dates, compute Spearman RankIC for each date using scipy.stats.spearmanr, compute rolling IC with pd.Series.rolling(), compute ICIR as mean/std, compute ic_positive_ratio as count(IC>0)/total
Return frozen ICAnalysisResult with all statistics
logic_flow: Extract unique dates from factor_values MultiIndex
For each date: extract factor values and forward returns, drop NaN, compute RankIC using spearmanr
Build IC series from per-date RankIC values
Compute statistics: ic_mean, ic_std, icir, rank_ic_mean, rank_ic_std, rank_icir, ic_positive_ratio

implementation.title: Write unit tests for ICAnalyzer
implementation.description: Create tests/unit/test_ic_analyzer.py with 6+ test cases: RankIC correctness against known correlation, ICIR computation, rolling window size, edge cases (empty data, insufficient stocks), frozen dataclass immutability.
modification_points: Test RankIC matches scipy.stats.spearmanr for known data
Test rolling IC window parameter controls output length
Test edge case: empty DataFrame returns empty ICAnalysisResult
Test edge case: < min_periods dates returns default ICAnalysisResult
logic_flow: Create synthetic factor and return DataFrames with known correlation
Compute IC and verify against expected Spearman correlation
Verify ICIR computation matches manual calculation
Test rolling window produces correct-length output

rationale.why_cross_sectional: Standard factor research uses cross-sectional IC (multiple stocks at single date), not time-series IC
rationale.why_spearman: RankIC is robust to outliers and measures monotonic relationship, preferred for factor evaluation

risks.mitigation: Check if scipy is already imported; if not, use pandas corr(method='spearman') as alternative
Skip dates with < min_stocks (10) valid pairs, log warning
